title: Settled sheets still force downloads
description: When `tap()` prompts about a timed-out share, it sets `downloadNext = true`, but a later settlement clears `pending` without clearing that download mode. If the sheet then succeeds, the next newly received photo downloads instead of opening the share sheet; if it is cancelled, the next tap downloads the original photos despite the cancellation.

title: Hung share keeps its photos out of Save all
description: `tap()` adds every ready pid to `pending` before awaiting the share sheet, and `batch(new Set([...handed, ...pending]))` then excludes those pids from all later batches. When `SHARE_TIMEOUT` expires, the timer only clears `busy`; it does not remove the `pending` entries, so a sheet that never settles leaves its photos permanently excluded for the session. Once no other photos are ready, every later tap returns `Still saving` and those photos can never be downloaded or shared again.
